intro.title: Cookie-Based Auth Flow
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple login form that authenticates a user using a cookie-based authentication flow. You will learn how to send user credentials to a mock server and handle the secure cookie it returns. The core programming concept involves managing authentication state and making HTTP requests. You will use Vue's reactive state, event handlers, and the Fetch API to implement this common web security pattern.
intro.usecase: Cookie-based authentication is the backbone of user sessions in countless web applications, from e-commerce sites like Amazon to social platforms like Facebook. As a developer, you'll implement this flow to manage secure login/logout in admin dashboards, customer portals, and SaaS products, where users expect to stay logged in across visits. This pattern handles sensitive operations—like updating profiles or accessing paid content—by automatically sending credentials with each request, ensuring a seamless and secure user experience without manual token management.
